gbm_population_evidence.quote: Persons with recurrent or progressive grade 4 glioma (glioblastoma) are eligible for this study.

candidate_evidence.quote: In this study we use Visudyne by itself like chemotherapy to kill tumor cells which may be sensitive to verteporfin.
[EXPERIMENTAL] Treatment (verteporfin): Patients receive verteporfin IV over 83 minutes weekly for 6 weeks in cycle 1

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Persons with recurrent or progressive grade 4 glioma (glioblastoma) are eligible for this study.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: To describe pharmacokinetics of Visudyne administered on a weekly schedule. (Phase I)

role_evidence.quote: [DRUG] Verteporfin (other names: Benzoporphyrin Derivative Monoacid Ring A, BPD-MA, Visudyne): Given IV
Visudyne is FDA approved in combination with light to treat eye diseases. In this study we use Visudyne by itself like chemotherapy to kill tumor cells which may be sensitive to verteporfin.

agents.drug_class_hint: photosensitiser (liposomal benzoporphyrin derivative) approved for ophthalmic photodynamic therapy; used here without light

source_quote.quote: Eligible participants have tumors that show mutant or amplified EGFR.

flag.reason: EGFR mutation/amplification is an entry requirement for verteporfin, but the record states no mechanistic link between verteporfin and EGFR; match status could change the primary outcome.

coder_notes: Bevacizumab and TTFields may be continued by some participants but are not registered interventions and not given to every patient, so not listed. PK is planned but the sample type is not stated, so tumour_pk_planned = unclear. Visudyne is liposomal verteporfin, the approved product itself, so formulation_flag none; it is given IV without light activation (not device-dependent). 'Grade 4 glioma (glioblastoma)' without IDH requirement coded historical.
